display.purpose: Big stat numbers and the single hero figure a screen leads with.

headline.purpose: Page titles and primary card titles.

title.purpose: Section headers, patient names, list-item titles.

body.purpose: Content, descriptions, form values. Always Ink, not Muted Ink.

label.purpose: Field labels, badges, status text, meta.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Inputs and quiet containers at rest (shadow-sm).

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Default elevation for stat/patient cards and panels (card-shadow).

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Hover state for interactive cards; popovers and dialogs (shadow-lg).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single 'do the main thing' action. Solid teal, deepens on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Add Patient</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:40px; padding:0 16px; background:#2a9d90; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:10px; font-family:Cairo,sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:14px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#1c6a61; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:#185a52; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #2a9d90; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Quiet alternative action. Hover stays calm with a teal-wash — never the vivid orange accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:40px; padding:0 16px; background:#f9fbfb; color:#1d2930; border:1px solid #dce5e5; border-radius:10px; font-family:Cairo,sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:14px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:#eaf5f4; border-color:#2a9d90; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #2a9d90; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Text field on the canvas fill with a teal focus ring. Placeholder stays high-contrast.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search patients by name or file no." />
components.css: .ds-input { height:40px; width:280px; max-width:100%; padding:0 12px; background:#f9fbfb; color:#1d2930; border:1px solid #dce5e5; border-radius:10px; font-family:Cairo,sans-serif; font-size:14px; transition:border-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:rgba(29,41,48,.55); } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#2a9d90; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #2a9d90; }

components.name: Tonal Icon Tile
components.description: The system's way to give an icon weight without a border or hard block: a 10% tint fill with the icon in the full color.
components.css: .ds-icon-tile-lg { width:64px; height:64px; border-radius:16px; background:#eaf5f4; color:#2a9d90; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill for status and counts. Solid teal default; semantic fills for state.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; border-radius:9999px; padding:2px 10px; background:#2a9d90; color:#fff; font-family:Cairo,sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Allergy Alert
components.description: Signature tinted-block alert: 10% red wash with solid red text. The model for all attention blocks — never a colored stripe.

narrative.overview: Roashetta should feel like a well-run consulting room: ordered, unhurried, everything in its place, nothing shouting. The teal that carries the system is the color of a freshly-prepared exam room — clean and clinical, but never icy. The interface earns trust by receding so the patient's data is always the loudest thing on screen. The system is warm, not cold: warmth is a deliberate goal carried by soft teal, the rounded Cairo typeface, generous padding, and tonal tints instead of hard rules and grey boxes. Color is restrained — teal does almost all the work; the vivid orange is held in reserve for the one moment that needs it.
keyCharacteristics: One family, many weights: Cairo carries Arabic and Latin with equal craft.
Teal is the single action color; orange is a rare highlight, not décor.
Tonal washes (10% tints) and soft ink-tinted shadows convey depth — not stripes, not glass.
Generous rounding (12-16px) and 24px padding make a dense domain feel calm.
Hierarchy over density everywhere, hardest in data: lead with the one number that matters.

rules.name: The One Teal Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only color allowed to mean 'action' or 'selected.' If two things on a screen are teal, they are both interactive or both the current thing — never decoration.

rules.name: The Reserved-Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange appears at most once per screen, and never as a default hover. It is the brand's exception; its rarity is what makes it read as 'look here.'

rules.name: The Reading-Contrast Rule
rules.body: Muted Ink (#67777e) clears 4.5:1 on white cards but only ~4.4:1 on the tinted canvas. Body copy that must be read uses Ink (#1d2930); Muted Ink is for secondary labels on white surfaces. Never light-grey body text for elegance.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes are a fixed rem scale, not fluid clamp(). Users sit at consistent DPI in a clinic; a heading that shrinks in a sidebar looks worse, not designed.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Face Rule
rules.body: Need more emphasis? Go up in weight or size within Cairo. Never introduce a second font family for hierarchy — the bilingual unity is worth more than contrast.

rules.name: The Lift-on-Touch Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest soft (shadow-sm/card-shadow). Elevation increases only as feedback — hover, drag, open. A card that already floats high at rest has nowhere to go on interaction.

rules.name: The Ink-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted with the ink hue, never rgba(0,0,0,...). Pure-black shadows on a teal-tinted canvas read muddy and cold.

dos: Do keep teal as the single action/selection color, and let one screen have at most one orange moment.
Do convey depth with ink-tinted soft shadows and 10% tonal washes; lift surfaces only on interaction.
Do use full tinted blocks for alerts (bg-destructive/10 with solid red text) — the allergy banner is the model.
Do lead every data surface with the single number that matters, then reveal detail; give analytics breathing room.
Do set body text in Ink (#1d2930); reserve Muted Ink for secondary labels on white cards.
Do build Arabic (RTL) as a first-class layout — mirror direction, flip chevrons and the sidebar, verify Cairo at every weight.
Do give interactive surfaces all states: default, hover, focus (2px teal ring + offset), active, disabled, loading.
donts: Don't ship anything that reads sterile and cold — no icy-grey forms, hairline-cramped density, or hard black shadows.
Don't build cluttered analytics dashboards — no walls of equal-weight charts and numbers with no hierarchy.
Don't let the vivid orange accent flash on outline/ghost button hovers; hover to a teal-wash or mist tint instead.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text over a gradient — the .text-gradient utility). Emphasis via weight and size.
Don't use glassmorphism as a default (.glass-effect blur cards). Rare and purposeful, or not at all.
Don't use a thick colored border-left/border-right as a stripe; use a full tinted block or a leading icon tile.
Don't introduce a second font family or fluid clamp() headings — one Cairo, fixed rem scale.
Don't nest cards, or place white cards directly on white with no tint/divider between them.
